precious <$cdef(27)>pearl...
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>S-so I was wondering... Could you use it to make me
a sofa?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,2)>Eu sou um pouco descuidado, e estou preocupado que eu possa perder isso
precioso <$cdef(27)>pérola...
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Então, estava a pensar...
Um sofá?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,55)><$facial(4,14)><$voicel(4,3)>Also, after you’ve made the sofa, could you put it by
my home?
<$emotion(4,6)><$voicel(4,7)>Then the <$cdef(27)>pearl you got me can be with me forever...
That sounds so nice...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,55)><$facial(4,14)><$voicel(4,3)>Além disso, depois de ter feito o sofá, você poderia colocá-lo por
A minha casa?
<$emotion(4,6)><$voicel(4,7)>Então, o <$cdef(27)>pérola pode ficar comigo para sempre...
Isso parece tão bom...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,39)>C-could you put a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(458)></color> in my home, please...?

dialogues.en:
<$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,9)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, you put a<$cdef(27)> <$ifull(458)> in my home? <$emotion(4,39)><$voicel(4,8)>Thank you,
<$cdef(27)>!
You’re amazing...
<$voicel(4,9)><$motionoff(4,804)><$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,10)>All right... N-now it’s my turn to help you out! <$emotion(4,64)><$voicel(4,6)>Is there

<$cdef(27)>!
Você é incrível...
<$voicel(4,9)><$motionoff(4,804)><$facial(4,1)><$comeff(4,10)>Tudo bem... Agora é a minha vez de ajudá-lo! <$emotion(4,64)><$voicel(4,6)>Existe?

<$emotion(4,27)><$voicel(4,9)><$cdef(27)><$cname(562)> needs help? Ohhh, they’re trying to build a big
building? <$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,21)><$voicel(4,8)>Th-that sounds...fun!
<$facial(0,1)><$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,4)>In that case, let me know when you’re ready to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>.
